description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android project. It specifies a method for logging messages with different priorities, tags, optional exceptions, and the ability to chain log nodes for flexible log handling.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface representing a node in a logging chain, responsible for outputting log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with a given priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
